pitch: Become an elite SWAT commander and bring order to a city overwhelmed by chaos and corruption.

First-person tactical shooter. Lead a five-person SWAT-style team breaching and clearing rooms in a crime-ridden fictional city. Use door wedges, mirrors, flashbangs, less-lethal tools, and real firearms with realistic bullet penetration. Hostage and suspect deaths carry lasting psychological weight for your operators. Missions confront trafficking, drug cartels, arms dealing, and terrorism. Co-op for up to five players with crossplay. Grim, procedural, punishing realism over arcade action.
Embark on a gripping journey in the game, an atmospheric FPS set in Cold War-era East Berlin. Unravel the secrets of a mysterious parallel dimension while searching for a missing colleague.

A first-person shooter set the night the Berlin Wall falls. The heroine slips into a hidden parallel dimension inside an abandoned Cold War research complex, hunting for a vanished colleague. Roughly four hours of story-driven combat across five weapons, a moody synth-and-acoustic score, and surreal, dreamlike industrial environments where time itself seems to stop and dark secrets wait underground.
Explore a throbbing pink world full of strange naked creatures to gather food for your friend in this short, surreal experience.

A short, surreal walking-sim style exploration game. Third-person, no combat, no dialogue: you wander a vivid, throbbing pink world inhabited by strange nude, unsettling creatures, gathering food to bring back to a companion. Hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation, an original ambient score, and a dreamlike, psychologically uncanny tone somewhere between cute and horror. Free-to-play, single-player, built for one quiet sitting rather than a full game loop.
A bullet hell roguelike game. Players can utilize characters with different abilities, collect and assemble powerful items.

Dodge overwhelming bullet patterns as a top-down shooter hero in a run-based roguelike. Pick from eight distinct playable characters, each with unique abilities, then build wild combinations from a pool of over 200 collectible items across each procedurally generated run. Every match tightens as an expanding black hole slowly swallows the arena, forcing frantic repositioning until the last screen closes. Fast, replayable, and built for build-crafting fans who love screen-filling danger.

Take on the role of one of the notorious killer family, or their victims, in the game, a third-person asymmetrical horror experience based on the groundbreaking and iconic 1974 horror film. Experience the mad and macabre for yourself in the game.

Third-person asymmetrical multiplayer horror. One side plays desperate victims who must sneak, hide, and scavenge tools to escape a remote rural killing ground. The other side plays a family of relentless slasher-movie killers hunting them down with brutal melee weapons. Tense stealth, environmental traps, gory kills, high-stakes survival horror inspired by 1970s grindhouse slasher films.
The award-winning game is the latest edition in the series. A grand strategy title in the space 4X (explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate) genre.

Turn-based 4X strategy set deep in space. Research a full tech tree, design custom starships from the hull up, fight tactical fleet battles, colonize and manage star systems, meet and negotiate with alien species, crush internal rebellions, and build your own scenarios and mods with the included campaign tools. Serious, systems-heavy sci-fi empire management for single-player strategy veterans who want deep economic and military control.

The game is a fast-paced movement-based roguelite shooter you can enjoy solo or up to 3 friends. Pick your hero, try out different builds, and jump into chaotic arenas filled with unpredictable robots.

A fast, movement-driven third-person roguelike shooter for solo play or three-player co-op. Choose a hero class, each with a distinct traversal ability - dash, hover, or slash - then mix weapons and augments into synergistic builds. Fight through procedurally varied arenas, from lava fields to eerie caves, against swarms of hostile robots. Runs are brutal and short; death teaches the next attempt. Tone is gritty sci-fi survival, stylized visuals, high lethality, high replay value.
A strategic tower defense game where, as the story progresses, the player uses items collected from each scene to lower the strength of a supernatural seductress so she cannot enter human society.

Tower-defense strategy with light dating-sim elements. Place defenses and gather items between story scenes to weaken a supernatural antagonist and keep her from crossing into the human world. Turn-based skirmishes mix with puzzle-platformer stages, casual pacing, third-person perspective, and adult-themed art that unlocks as chapters progress.
Piloting a wide range of aircraft, players engage in aerial battles and dangerous fighter missions across the major theaters of war during WWII.

Climb into the cockpit of an authentic World War II fighter plane. Choose from over 40 real aircraft, including legendary Allied and Axis machines, then take to the skies in tense aerial combat. Arcade-friendly flight controls keep it accessible while historically accurate models nail period detail. Fly solo missions or team up in local split-screen co-op, battling enemy squadrons across the major fronts of the war.
The game is a free multiplayer PVP game where you can fight friends or randoms on an island arena

Free-to-play first-person shooter where buccaneers battle across island arenas. Grab cutlasses, pistols and cannons to take down friends or strangers in fast, cartoonish combat. Unlock hats, weapon skins and title cards, then dance on your kills with goofy emotes. Switch between Team Deathmatch, Free-For-All and King of the Cannon for different flavors of chaotic multiplayer mayhem. Silly, violent, built for quick matches.
In this game, you do indeed, click on a button. The more you click, the more the game evolves. Select new abilities that align with your playstyle.

A top-down arena shooter built around a single button: clicking it fires an ever-evolving barrage of bullets around you. Level up mid-run, choose new abilities, and stack builds into a screen-filling bullet-hell defense. Play endless for maximum chaos, or steer your ability picks toward one of four distinct endings. Roguelike progression, arcade pacing, one core mechanic.
The game is a free, multiplayer, deception-based shooter. Betray your friends and sniff out the rogue agent.

A free eight-player social-deduction shooter set in a stylish 70s super-mansion built around a volcano lair. Most players are agents racing to stop a missile launch; one traitor works covertly to sabotage them. Fast, third-person combat, four unique characters with distinct abilities, short match lengths, comedic tone, no ads, no microtransactions. Think Mafia-style betrayal fused with punchy multiplayer shooting.
Choose your tag team and rip through massive hordes of enemies with exciting aerial and ground-based combos.

Anime hack-and-slash brawler where you tag-team two goddess warriors through waves of enemies, chaining ground and aerial combos in colorful 1080p arenas. Battle damage rips characters costumes, weakening defense but charging special-attack gauges for over-the-top finishing moves. Comedic story missions from rival gossip journalists drive a singleplayer, third-person action RPG with light JRPG progression, mature fan-service content alongside the cartoonish humor.

The game is a fun first person-cat video game. Your goal is to chase rats and mice, break things, eat, and do other things that cats do... You will experience the joy of hunting mice and rats while racking up points by knocking things over. Cause as much destruction as you possibly can!

First-person animal life sim with slapstick chaos. Play as a mischievous house pet stalking rodents through a suburban home, knocking over lamps, vases and dishes to rack up destruction points. Comedic, low-stakes sandbox tone, open-world exploration of rooms and yards, physics-based mayhem, early access indie project still full of jank and bugs but funny because of it.
This game is an extremely challenging stealth-action hybrid that allows you to take control of the reaper to quell the recent undead uprising.

A pixel-art top-down stealth-action game where you play death's own enforcer, and one hit means you're gone. Infiltrate mob hideouts and monster dens, choosing loud guns-blazing runs or silent takedowns across 25+ noir-lit levels. Unlock 30+ weapons, face 35+ undead and criminal enemy types, trigger over-the-top gore, and groove to a genre-hopping soundtrack. Build your own levels with the included map editor. Dark humor, brutal difficulty, satisfying permadeath tension throughout.
The game is a hardcore sidescroller. You're a hero, there are robots, you've got ten seconds to destroy them all.

A shockingly fast, hardcore 2D action-puzzle platformer. Side-scrolling view, one kidnapped hero must destroy waves of robots before a strict time limit runs out, across 100 tight levels in 11 worlds. Ghost replays show your best run, leaderboards reward speed, hidden minigames and unlockable costumes add replay value. Precision movement, split-second reflexes, time-attack pacing throughout.
Hanging out with friends, bombing walls, and smashing bottles would be much more fun with out the jail time.

A multiplayer VR graffiti simulator where up to four players spray realistic paint together across urban locations: rooftops, train yards, an abandoned subway station, and sandbox spaces with varied surfaces. Pick caps, colors, and pressure for authentic drips and fades, then replay your session from any angle or a cinematic camera. Explore an interactive world, snap photos, and project sketches onto walls. First-person, casual pick-up-and-paint creativity for solo or group sessions.

Have you ever wanted to poop on revelers but were too socially awkward to just go for it? Well, the game is about to change all that, the player will find themselves in the middle of a raw human story of existential panic.

A rhythm-based simulator: travel to exotic worldwide locations, eat local food on the beat, then hurl projectiles at crowds of guests to score points and unlock new venues. Dark comedy, over-the-top, third-person social-chaos gameplay with custom music tracks and Steam Workshop character mods and animations.
Create and command your own customizable squads of fighting robots in this turn-based, arena tactics game.

Build and customize squads of fighting robots, then battle other commanders in turn-based arena tactics. Deploy unit types like grabbers, flippers, and mortars, climb bronze to gold leagues in multiplayer deathmatch and control modes, or run a career managing rosters, trades, stat upgrades, and sponsorships across seasons. Tackle daily AI challenges on random maps for leaderboard glory. Personalize your commander and arena with hundreds of cosmetic combinations.

CLOSE YOUR EYES. BECOME A WARRIOR: Feel your enemys rasping breath; a foot shifts on swampy ground; the crack of steel on wooden shield. The game is an audio based action adventure that sets out to breathe new life into medieval combat and fantasy narrative.

Audio-only action-adventure RPG starring a blind protagonist who survives on sound alone: footsteps, breathing, steel on shield. Fully 3D binaural audio drives real-time melee combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving. Equip weapons and armor, learn magic abilities, recruit companions, and shape a playstyle across a 5+ hour story of family betrayal, a stolen throne, and a trek through hostile, secret-laden territory. Built for blind and sighted players alike; headphones strongly recommended.
a gritty post-apocalyptic role playing game that allows players to discover the horrors of the apocalypse through a harsh struggle for survival.
